    Pack contains:

    a CD-rip of the original album in 16/44.1, with "dive" and "still blue" added at the end
    01 fountain
    02 hunting for pearls / pearl
    03 vista / melter
    04 tap your glass
    05 blue blue
    06 thin
    07 chasing kites
    08 ripple / arrival
    09 the last dancer
    10 shadowshow
    11. dive
    12. sails / still blue
    ——————————
    NOTES: Tracks flow into each other. This is exclusive to the CD and vinyl versions. All tracks have their own embedded cover.
    11 and 12 are added from the Islanders edition and Qobuz, respectively, and have been slightly crossfaded to continue the album's flow.

    "Blue (Instrumental)" album in 256bk/s AAC
    01 fountain
    02 hunting for pearls
    03 vista
    04 tap your glass
    05 blue blue
    06 thin
    07 chasing kites
    08 ripple
    09 the last dancer
    10 shadowshow

    "Book" (digital booklet)

    "Episodes" - a folder for each song containing its video in master format, cover, animated GIF cover, lyrics, and an associated image from the booklet
    Ripple, The Last Dancer, and Shadowshow were sourced from twimc's Vimeo and are smaller files. No video for Dive. No lyrics and image for Ripple.

    "Film": BLUE (2014) (1080p TWIMC WEB-DL x264 AVC 2.0)
